projects.title: ResumeFeed
projects.description: A resume feedback network — post a resume to a shared feed and get a 1-5 star rating, quick reactions, and Reddit-style threaded comments back. A Turborepo monorepo pairing a Next.js web app with an Express/TypeORM API on Supabase Auth and Postgres.
